phase: metadata-only review before any S4 numeric effect parsing
documented_processing: The Methods describe different assay cell panels for complex-trait and eQTL libraries.
Variants with fewer than30 DNA counts or exactly0 RNA counts for either allele are excluded from downstream analysis.
When a variant occurs in several libraries, the source selects the library with the highest documented plasmid support.
S4 reports the best measurement across libraries chosen per variant per cell type.

targeted_checks.source: Official Supplementary Table4 legend in MOESM1
targeted_checks.result: The legend is only MPRA result summary; no NA or blank-token convention is defined.

targeted_checks.source: Official S4 OpenXML archive and first two text rows
targeted_checks.result: Ten standard package members contain no cell-comment, custom-license, or annotation member. Title/header rows define columns but no missing-token convention. Numeric effect cells were not inspected.

The inspected preprocessing code reads paired RDS results and writes intermediate compressed text tables; it does not establish the final S4 XLSX export or its missing-token encoding. Generic R writer defaults are not substituted for that missing provenance.

missing_policy.evidence: No literal missing-value token was established by the targeted source metadata review. The frozen v1 therefore accepts none. Any required nonordinary-finite numeric value must stop the source gate and remain documented.

limits: Untested or filtered measurements are plausible from the source design, but that does not identify a particular final-workbook token. No accepted missing token was chosen after inspecting its effect distribution, presence, or predictive performance.
